  intros j' ls' E'; destruct (Nat.ltb_spec j' j) as [Hlt | _]; [ exact (IH _ Hlt _ E') | discriminate ].
Qed.

The leaf paths of a recursive argument of a closed group's constructor end in members at their numbers of parameters.
Lemma cargs_leaves_params_length : forall D k M c gs gs1 t gs2 m, decl_closed D -> ind_member D k = Some M ->
    In (c, gs) (im_cons M) -> gs = gs1 ++ ca_rec t :: gs2 ->
    List.Forall (leaf_params_length D) (shape_leaves (rview_leaves D) m t).
Proof.
  intros * HD HM Hin E; pose proof (decl_closed_members _ HD _ _ HM) as HMc.
  apply shape_leaves_params_length; [ exact (rview_leaves_params_length D HD) | exact (member_closed_rec_len _ _ HMc _ _ Hin _ _ _ E) ].
Qed.

Lemma leaf_ih_scoped : forall r pq D l Us Bks σ M m k,
    decl_closed D -> List.length Us = ind_nu D -> List.Forall (exp_scoped m) Us ->
    blocks_binder_count_ok D Bks -> blocks_scoped m Bks ->
    (forall x, x < k -> sentry_scoped m (σ x)) -> leaf_scoped k l -> exp_scoped m M ->
    exp_scoped m (leaf_ih r pq Us Bks σ M l).
Proof.
  intros r pq D l; induction l as [k0 Ps | B l IH | f ns l IH]; intros * HD Hl HUs Hnm HBs Hσ Ht HM; cbn in *.
  - split; [ apply all_list_Forall; exact HUs | split; assumption ].
  - destruct Ht as [HB Ht]; split; [ eapply exp_scoped_sub; eassumption |].
    eapply IH; [ exact HD | rewrite length_map; exact Hl | | apply blocks_binder_count_ok_wk; exact Hnm | | apply sb_q_bound; exact Hσ | exact Ht | ].
    + apply List.Forall_map; eapply List.Forall_impl; [| exact HUs ]; intros U HU; apply exp_scoped_shift; exact HU.
    + eapply blocks_wk_scoped; [ exact HBs |]; cbn; lia.
    + cbn; split; [ apply exp_scoped_shift; exact HM | lia ].
  - eapply IH; [ exact HD | exact Hl | exact HUs | exact Hnm | exact HBs | | exact Ht | exact HM ].
    replace (List.length ns + k) with (List.length (projections_of ns M) + k) by (unfold projections_of; rewrite List.length_map; reflexivity).
    apply sb_of_list_bound; [ exact Hσ |].
    unfold projections_of; apply List.Forall_map, List.Forall_forall; intros; exact HM.
Qed.

Lemma elim_ihs_scoped : forall r pq D Us Bks gs σ As m n k,
    decl_closed D -> List.length Us = ind_nu D -> List.Forall (exp_scoped m) Us ->
    blocks_binder_count_ok D Bks -> blocks_scoped m Bks -> k = n + ind_nu D ->
    (forall x, x < k -> sentry_scoped m (σ x)) ->
    (forall gs1 t gs2, gs = gs1 ++ ca_rec t :: gs2 -> ptyp_scoped (List.length (cargs_nonrec_ctx gs1) + k) t) ->
    List.Forall (exp_scoped m) As -> List.Forall (exp_scoped m) (elim_ihs r pq D Us Bks σ n gs As).
Proof.
  induction gs as [| [ra A0 | t] gs IH]; intros σ [| N As] m n k HD Hl HUs Hnm HBs Hk Hσ Ht HAs; cbn; try constructor;
    inversion_clear HAs.
  - eapply (IH _ _ _ (S n) (S k)); [ eassumption .. | lia | apply sb_ext_bound; assumption | | assumption ].
    intros gs1 t gs2 ->; specialize (Ht (ca_arg ra A0 :: gs1) t gs2 eq_refl); cbn in Ht; rewrite length_app in Ht; cbn in Ht.
    eapply ptyp_scoped_mono; [| exact Ht ]; lia.
  - apply List.Forall_app; split; [| eapply IH; [ eassumption .. | | assumption ] ].
    + apply List.Forall_map.
      pose proof (shape_leaves_scoped (rview_leaves D) (ind_nu D) t n (rview_leaves_scoped D HD)) as HL.
      specialize (Ht nil t gs eq_refl); cbn in Ht; subst k.
      eapply List.Forall_impl; [| exact (HL Ht) ]; intros l' Hl'.
      eapply leaf_ih_scoped; eassumption.
    + intros gs1 t' gs2 ->; exact (Ht (ca_rec t :: gs1) t' gs2 eq_refl).
Qed.

The recursive results of ι: the shapes' domains instantiated by the parameters and the arguments.
Lemma elim_ihs_scoped_at : forall r pq D k M c gs Bks Ps As m,
    decl_closed D -> ind_member D k = Some M -> ind_con M c = Some gs -> List.length Ps = im_np D M ->
    blocks_binder_count_ok D Bks -> blocks_scoped m Bks ->
    List.Forall (exp_scoped m) Ps -> List.Forall (exp_scoped m) As ->
    List.Forall (exp_scoped m) (elim_ihs r pq D (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps) Bks (sb_of_list Id Ps) (im_nn M) gs As).
Proof.
  intros * Hc HM Hcon Hl Hnm HBs HPs HAs; pose proof (member_closed_recs _ _ (decl_closed_members _ Hc _ _ HM)) as Ht.
  eapply (elim_ihs_scoped _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ (List.length Ps + 0)); [ exact Hc | | | exact Hnm | exact HBs | | | | exact HAs ].
  - rewrite List.length_firstn; unfold im_np in Hl; lia.
  - apply Forall_firstn'; exact HPs.
  - unfold im_np in Hl; lia.
  - apply sb_of_list_bound; [ intros; lia | exact HPs ].
  - intros gs1 t gs2 E; rewrite Nat.add_0_r, Hl; exact (Ht _ _ _ _ _ (cons_lookup_in _ _ _ Hcon) E).
Qed.

The motive's instance at the non-uniform parameters and the scrutinee.
Lemma elim_inst_scoped : forall D M A Ps N m,
    List.length Ps = im_np D M ->
    exp_scoped (S (im_nn M) + m) A -> List.Forall (exp_scoped m) Ps -> exp_scoped m N ->
    exp_scoped m A[sb_of_list Id (List.skipn (ind_nu D) Ps ++ N :: nil)].
Proof.
  intros * Hl HA HPs HN; apply exp_scoped_sb_of_list.
  - rewrite length_app, length_skipn; cbn; unfold im_np in *; replace (length Ps - ind_nu D + 1 + m) with (S (im_nn M + m)) by lia; exact HA.
  - apply List.Forall_app; split; [| constructor; auto ].
    exact (Forall_skipn' _ _ _ HPs).
Qed.

Lemma elim_brs_scoped_l : forall r p D M Us As Bs (Bs' : list (String.string * nat * exp)) m,
    brs_names (im_cons M) Bs ->
    List.map fst Bs = List.map fst Bs' ->
    (forall c gs n B, ind_con M c = Some gs -> In (c, n, B) Bs -> n = (im_nn M + List.length gs + cargs_nrec D gs)%nat) ->
    (forall k c gs n B B', nth_error Bs k = Some (c, n, B) -> nth_error Bs' k = Some (c, n, B') ->
       ind_con M c = Some gs -> exp_scoped (List.length (elim_bctx r p D M gs As Us) + m) B) ->
    all_brs (fun k B => exp_scoped (k + m) B) Bs.
Proof.
  intros * Hn Hm Hk HB; eapply elim_brs_scoped; [ eassumption | eassumption |].
  intros * Hgs Hin.
  destruct (List.In_nth_error _ _ Hin) as [k Hk'].
  destruct (brs_nth_same _ _ _ _ _ _ Hm Hk') as [B' HkB'].
  eauto.
Qed.

The blocks of an eliminator, read position by position.
Lemma all_blocks_nth : forall {A : Set} (f : nat -> A -> A -> list (String.string * nat * A) -> Prop) Bks,
    (forall k b, List.nth_error Bks k = Some b -> f (eb_binder_count b) (eb_scrutinee_type b) (eb_motive b) (eb_brs b)) ->
    all_blocks f Bks.
Proof.
  induction Bks as [| [nm Z M Bs] Bks IH]; intros H; cbn; [ exact I |].
  split; [ exact (H 0 _ eq_refl) | apply IH; intros k b Hk; exact (H (S k) b Hk) ].
Qed.

Lemma all_blocks_nth_inv : forall {A : Set} (f : nat -> A -> A -> list (String.string * nat * A) -> Prop) Bks k b,
    all_blocks f Bks -> List.nth_error Bks k = Some b -> f (eb_binder_count b) (eb_scrutinee_type b) (eb_motive b) (eb_brs b).
Proof.
  induction Bks as [| [nm Z M Bs] Bks IH]; intros * H Hk; [ destruct k; discriminate |].
  destruct H as [Hb H]; destruct k as [| k]; cbn in Hk; [ injection Hk as <-; exact Hb | exact (IH _ _ H Hk) ].
Qed.

Lemma blocks_scoped_nth : forall m Bks k b, blocks_scoped m Bks -> List.nth_error Bks k = Some b ->
    exp_scoped (eb_binder_count b - 1 + m) (eb_scrutinee_type b) /\ exp_scoped (eb_binder_count b + m) (eb_motive b) /\
    all_brs (fun k B => exp_scoped (k + m) B) (eb_brs b).
Proof. intros * H Hk; exact (all_blocks_nth_inv _ _ _ _ H Hk). Qed.

Lemma nth_error_member : forall D (Bks : list eblock) k b,
    List.length Bks = ind_nblk D -> List.nth_error Bks k = Some b ->
    exists Mk, ind_member D k = Some Mk.
Proof.
  intros * Hl Hk; unfold ind_member.
  destruct (List.nth_error (ind_members D) k) eqn:E; [ eauto |].
  apply List.nth_error_None in E; assert (Hk' : List.nth_error Bks k <> None) by congruence.
  apply List.nth_error_Some in Hk'; pose proof (ind_nblk_le D); lia.
Qed.

The blocks of an eliminator, scoped, from what typing says of each: the scrutinee type under the member's non-uniform parameters, the motive under them and the scrutinee, each branch under its context.
Lemma elim_blocks_scoped : forall r p D Us Bks m,
    List.length Bks = ind_nblk D ->
    blocks_binder_count_ok D Bks ->
    (forall k Mk b, ind_member D k = Some Mk -> List.nth_error Bks k = Some b ->
       exp_scoped (im_nn Mk + m) (eb_scrutinee_type b)) ->
    (forall k Mk b, ind_member D k = Some Mk -> List.nth_error Bks k = Some b ->
       exp_scoped (S (im_nn Mk) + m) (eb_motive b)) ->
    (forall k Mk b, ind_member D k = Some Mk -> List.nth_error Bks k = Some b -> brs_names (im_cons Mk) (eb_brs b)) ->
    (forall k Mk b c gs n B, ind_member D k = Some Mk -> List.nth_error Bks k = Some b ->
       ind_con Mk c = Some gs -> In (c, n, B) (eb_brs b) -> n = (im_nn Mk + List.length gs + cargs_nrec D gs)%nat) ->
    (forall k Mk b c gs n B, ind_member D k = Some Mk -> List.nth_error Bks k = Some b ->
       ind_con Mk c = Some gs -> In (c, n, B) (eb_brs b) ->
       exp_scoped (List.length (elim_bctx r p D Mk gs (blocks_motives Bks) Us) + m) B) ->
    blocks_scoped m Bks.
Proof.
  intros * Hl Hnm HZ HA Hn Hk HB; apply all_blocks_nth; intros k b Hb.
  destruct (nth_error_member _ _ _ _ Hl Hb) as [Mk HMk].
  pose proof (Hnm _ _ _ HMk Hb) as Enm.
  split; [| split ].
  - rewrite Enm; replace (S (im_nn Mk) - 1 + m) with (im_nn Mk + m) by lia; exact (HZ _ _ _ HMk Hb).
  - rewrite Enm; exact (HA _ _ _ HMk Hb).
  - eapply elim_brs_scoped; [ exact (Hn _ _ _ HMk Hb) | intros; eapply Hk; eassumption | intros; eapply HB; eassumption ].
Qed.

The same where the branches are given position by position against the left blocks' (elim_brs_scoped').
Lemma elim_blocks_scoped' : forall r p D Us Bks Bks' m,
    List.length Bks' = ind_nblk D ->
    blocks_binder_count_ok D Bks' ->
    (forall k Mk b, ind_member D k = Some Mk -> List.nth_error Bks' k = Some b ->
       exp_scoped (im_nn Mk + m) (eb_scrutinee_type b)) ->
    (forall k Mk b b', ind_member D k = Some Mk -> List.nth_error Bks k = Some b -> List.nth_error Bks' k = Some b' ->
       exp_scoped (S (im_nn Mk) + m) (eb_motive b')) ->
    (forall k Mk b, ind_member D k = Some Mk -> List.nth_error Bks k = Some b -> brs_names (im_cons Mk) (eb_brs b)) ->
    (forall k b b', List.nth_error Bks k = Some b -> List.nth_error Bks' k = Some b' ->
       List.map fst (eb_brs b) = List.map fst (eb_brs b')) ->
    (forall k Mk b c gs n B, ind_member D k = Some Mk -> List.nth_error Bks k = Some b ->
       ind_con Mk c = Some gs -> In (c, n, B) (eb_brs b) -> n = (im_nn Mk + List.length gs + cargs_nrec D gs)%nat) ->
    (forall k Mk b b' i c gs n B B', ind_member D k = Some Mk -> List.nth_error Bks k = Some b ->
       List.nth_error Bks' k = Some b' ->
       nth_error (eb_brs b) i = Some (c, n, B) -> nth_error (eb_brs b') i = Some (c, n, B') ->
       ind_con Mk c = Some gs ->
       exp_scoped (List.length (elim_bctx r p D Mk gs (blocks_motives Bks) Us) + m) B') ->
    List.length Bks = ind_nblk D ->
    blocks_scoped m Bks'.
Proof.
  intros * Hl' Hnm HZ HA Hn Hm Hk HB Hl; apply all_blocks_nth; intros k b' Hb'.
  destruct (nth_error_member _ _ _ _ Hl' Hb') as [Mk HMk].
  destruct (List.nth_error Bks k) as [b |] eqn:Hb;
    [| apply List.nth_error_None in Hb; assert (Hk' : List.nth_error Bks' k <> None) by congruence;
       apply List.nth_error_Some in Hk'; lia ].
  pose proof (Hnm _ _ _ HMk Hb') as Enm.
  split; [| split ].
  - rewrite Enm; replace (S (im_nn Mk) - 1 + m) with (im_nn Mk + m) by lia; exact (HZ _ _ _ HMk Hb').
  - rewrite Enm; exact (HA _ _ _ _ HMk Hb Hb').
  - eapply elim_brs_scoped'; [ exact (Hn _ _ _ HMk Hb) | exact (Hm _ _ _ Hb Hb') | intros; eapply Hk; eassumption |].
    intros; eapply HB; eassumption.
Qed.

The left blocks, where the branches are given position by position.
Lemma elim_blocks_scoped_l : forall r p D Us Bks (Bks' : list eblock) m,
    List.length Bks = ind_nblk D ->
    blocks_binder_count_ok D Bks ->
    (forall k Mk b, ind_member D k = Some Mk -> List.nth_error Bks k = Some b ->
       exp_scoped (im_nn Mk + m) (eb_scrutinee_type b)) ->
    (forall k Mk b, ind_member D k = Some Mk -> List.nth_error Bks k = Some b ->
       exp_scoped (S (im_nn Mk) + m) (eb_motive b)) ->
    (forall k Mk b, ind_member D k = Some Mk -> List.nth_error Bks k = Some b -> brs_names (im_cons Mk) (eb_brs b)) ->
    (forall k b b', List.nth_error Bks k = Some b -> List.nth_error Bks' k = Some b' ->
       List.map fst (eb_brs b) = List.map fst (eb_brs b')) ->
    (forall k Mk b c gs n B, ind_member D k = Some Mk -> List.nth_error Bks k = Some b ->
       ind_con Mk c = Some gs -> In (c, n, B) (eb_brs b) -> n = (im_nn Mk + List.length gs + cargs_nrec D gs)%nat) ->
    (forall k Mk b b' i c gs n B B', ind_member D k = Some Mk -> List.nth_error Bks k = Some b ->
       List.nth_error Bks' k = Some b' ->
       nth_error (eb_brs b) i = Some (c, n, B) -> nth_error (eb_brs b') i = Some (c, n, B') ->
       ind_con Mk c = Some gs ->
       exp_scoped (List.length (elim_bctx r p D Mk gs (blocks_motives Bks) Us) + m) B) ->
    List.length Bks' = ind_nblk D ->
    blocks_scoped m Bks.
Proof.
  intros * Hl Hnm HZ HA Hn Hm Hk HB Hl'; apply all_blocks_nth; intros k b Hb.
  destruct (nth_error_member _ _ _ _ Hl Hb) as [Mk HMk].
  destruct (List.nth_error Bks' k) as [b' |] eqn:Hb';
    [| apply List.nth_error_None in Hb'; assert (Hk' : List.nth_error Bks k <> None) by congruence;
       apply List.nth_error_Some in Hk'; lia ].
  pose proof (Hnm _ _ _ HMk Hb) as Enm.
  split; [| split ].
  - rewrite Enm; replace (S (im_nn Mk) - 1 + m) with (im_nn Mk + m) by lia; exact (HZ _ _ _ HMk Hb).
  - rewrite Enm; exact (HA _ _ _ HMk Hb).
  - eapply elim_brs_scoped_l; [ exact (Hn _ _ _ HMk Hb) | exact (Hm _ _ _ Hb Hb') | intros; eapply Hk; eassumption |].
    intros; eapply HB; eassumption.
Qed.

The uniform arguments of a member's type at uniform parameters as scoped as they are.
Lemma im_pre_scoped : forall D k M Us n,
    decl_closed D -> ind_member D k = Some M -> List.length Us = ind_nu D ->
    List.Forall (exp_scoped n) Us -> List.Forall (exp_scoped n) (im_pre M Us).
Proof.
  intros * HD HM Hl HUs; unfold im_pre.
  destruct (im_head M) as [pm | qc k' Is vm | qr Is fl] eqn:Hh; [ exact HUs | |].
  - apply List.Forall_map; eapply List.Forall_impl; [| exact (member_closed_head _ _ (decl_closed_members _ HD _ _ HM) _ _ _ _ Hh) ].
    intros I HI; apply exp_scoped_sb_of_list; [| exact HUs ].
    eapply exp_scoped_mono; [| exact HI ]; lia.
  - apply List.Forall_map; eapply List.Forall_impl; [| exact (member_closed_rhead _ _ (decl_closed_members _ HD _ _ HM) _ _ _ Hh) ].
    intros I HI; apply exp_scoped_sb_of_list; [| exact HUs ].
    eapply exp_scoped_mono; [| exact HI ]; lia.
Qed.

The Container's Blocks at a View


Lemma cargs_correspond_length : forall vm gs' gs, cargs_correspond vm gs' gs -> List.length gs' = List.length gs.
Proof.
  induction gs' as [| [] gs' IH]; intros [| [] gs] H; cbn in *; try contradiction; try reflexivity;
    f_equal; apply IH; tauto.
Qed.

Lemma length_wrap_leaves : forall D' t' ls ihs r' nr',
    List.length (wrap_leaves D' t' ls ihs r' nr') = Nat.min (List.length ls) (List.length ihs).
Proof.
  induction ls as [| l ls IH]; intros [| ih ihs] r' nr'; cbn; try reflexivity.
  destruct (leaf_in D' t' l); cbn; rewrite IH; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma length_wrap_ihs : forall D' D vm gs' gs ihs r' nr',
    cargs_correspond vm gs' gs -> List.length ihs = cargs_nrec D gs -> List.length (wrap_ihs D' D gs' gs ihs r' nr') = cargs_nrec D gs.
Proof.
  intros D' D vm; induction gs' as [| [] gs' IH]; intros [| [] gs] * H Hl; cbn in *; try contradiction; try reflexivity.
  - apply IH; tauto.
  - rewrite List.length_app, List.length_firstn, IH; [ lia | tauto | rewrite List.length_skipn; lia ].
  - rewrite List.length_app, length_wrap_leaves, List.length_firstn, IH; [ lia | tauto | rewrite List.length_skipn; lia ].
Qed.

Lemma wrap_leaves_scoped : forall D' t' ls ihs r' nr' N,
    nr' <= N -> 0 < N -> List.Forall (exp_scoped N) ihs -> List.Forall (exp_scoped N) (wrap_leaves D' t' ls ihs r' nr').
Proof.
  induction ls as [| l ls IH]; intros [| ih ihs] * HN HN0 Hihs; cbn; try constructor.
  inversion_clear Hihs.
  destruct (leaf_in D' t' l); constructor; try (apply IH; assumption); cbn; [ lia | assumption ].
Qed.

Lemma wrap_ihs_scoped : forall D' D vm gs' gs ihs r' nr' N,
    cargs_correspond vm gs' gs -> nr' <= N -> List.length gs' <= N ->
    List.Forall (exp_scoped N) ihs -> List.Forall (exp_scoped N) (wrap_ihs D' D gs' gs ihs r' nr').
Proof.
  intros D' D vm; induction gs' as [| [] gs' IH]; intros [| [] gs] * H HN Hg Hihs; cbn in *; try contradiction; try solve [ constructor ].
  - apply IH; [ tauto | lia | lia | exact Hihs ].
  - apply List.Forall_app; split; [ apply Forall_firstn'; exact Hihs | apply IH; [ tauto | lia | lia | apply Forall_skipn'; exact Hihs ] ].
  - apply List.Forall_app; split.
    + apply wrap_leaves_scoped; [ lia | lia | apply Forall_firstn'; exact Hihs ].
    + apply IH; [ tauto | lia | lia | apply Forall_skipn'; exact Hihs ].
Qed.

A branch of the container's block, scoped.
Lemma wrap_branch_scoped : forall r pq D D' vm Us Bks Mv Bs c gs' m,
    decl_closed D -> List.length Us = ind_nu D -> List.Forall (exp_scoped m) Us ->
    blocks_binder_count_ok D Bks -> blocks_scoped m Bks ->
    member_closed D Mv ->
    (forall gs, ind_con Mv c = Some gs -> cargs_correspond vm gs' gs) ->
    (exists gs, ind_con Mv c = Some gs) ->
    (forall gs n B, ind_con Mv c = Some gs -> In (c, n, B) Bs -> n = (im_nn Mv + List.length gs + cargs_nrec D gs)%nat) ->
    all_brs (fun k B => exp_scoped (k + m) B) Bs ->
    exp_scoped (snd (fst (wrap_branch r pq D D' Us Bks Mv Bs c gs')) + m) (snd (wrap_branch r pq D D' Us Bks Mv Bs c gs')).
Proof.
  intros * HD Hl HUs Hnm HBks HMv Hcorr [gs Hgs] Hn HBs; unfold wrap_branch; rewrite Hgs; cbn [fst snd].
  pose proof (Hcorr _ Hgs) as Hc; pose proof (cargs_correspond_length _ _ _ Hc) as Hlen.
  destruct (brs_lookup Bs c) as [[n B] |] eqn:Hb; [| exact I ].
  pose proof (Hn _ _ _ Hgs (brs_lookup_in _ _ _ _ Hb)) as En.
  assert (HB : exp_scoped (n + m) B).
  { rewrite all_brs_Forall, List.Forall_forall in HBs; exact (HBs _ (brs_lookup_in _ _ _ _ Hb)). }
  set (n' := (im_nn Mv + length gs' + cargs_nrec D' gs')%nat).
  match goal with |- exp_scoped _ (_[sb_of_list _ ?L]) =>
    assert (HL : List.length L = n) by
      (rewrite !length_app, !length_vars_from, (length_wrap_ihs _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hc) by
         (rewrite length_elim_ihs by (rewrite length_vars_from; lia); reflexivity); lia);
    eapply exp_scoped_sub; [ exact HB |]; rewrite <- HL; apply sb_of_list_bound;
      [ intros x Hx; cbn; unfold wk_shiftn; lia |]
  end.
  - assert (HUs' : List.Forall (exp_scoped (n' + m)) (List.map (fun U => U[wk_shiftn n']ʷ) Us)).
    { apply List.Forall_map; eapply List.Forall_impl; [| exact HUs ]; intros U HU.
      eapply exp_scoped_wk; [ exact HU |]; intros; unfold wk_shiftn; lia. }
    apply List.Forall_app; split; [| apply List.Forall_app; split ].
    + apply vars_from_scoped; subst n'; lia.
    + apply vars_from_scoped; subst n'; lia.
    + eapply wrap_ihs_scoped; [ exact Hc | subst n'; lia | subst n'; lia |].
      eapply (elim_ihs_scoped _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ (im_nn Mv) (List.length Us + im_nn Mv)).
      * exact HD.
      * rewrite length_map; exact Hl.
      * exact HUs'.
      * apply blocks_binder_count_ok_wk; exact Hnm.
      * eapply blocks_wk_scoped; [ exact HBks |]; intros; unfold wk_shiftn; lia.
      * lia.
      * intros x Hx; apply (sb_of_list_bound _ _ 0); [ intros y Hy; lia | | ].
        -- apply List.Forall_app; split; [ exact HUs' | apply vars_from_scoped; subst n'; lia ].
        -- rewrite length_app, length_map, length_vars_from; lia.
      * intros gs1 t gs2 E; pose proof (member_closed_recs _ _ HMv _ _ _ _ _ (cons_lookup_in _ _ _ Hgs) E) as Ht.
        eapply ptyp_scoped_mono; [| exact Ht ]; unfold im_np; lia.
      * apply vars_from_scoped; subst n'; lia.
Qed.

The container's blocks at a view, scoped.
Lemma view_wrap_scoped : forall r pq qc D D' vm Us Uc Bks m,
    decl_closed D -> view_wrap_ok D D' vm -> List.length Us = ind_nu D -> List.Forall (exp_scoped m) Us ->
    decl_closed D' -> List.length Uc = ind_nu D' -> List.Forall (exp_scoped m) Uc ->
    blocks_binder_count_ok D Bks -> blocks_scoped m Bks ->
    (forall k Mk b, ind_member D k = Some Mk -> List.nth_error Bks k = Some b -> brs_names (im_cons Mk) (eb_brs b)) ->
    (forall k Mk b c gs n B, ind_member D k = Some Mk -> List.nth_error Bks k = Some b ->
       ind_con Mk c = Some gs -> In (c, n, B) (eb_brs b) -> n = (im_nn Mk + List.length gs + cargs_nrec D gs)%nat) ->
    blocks_scoped m (view_wrap r pq qc D D' vm Us Uc Bks).
Proof.
  intros * HD Hvw Hl HUs HD' Hlc HUc Hnm HBks Hnames Hn; apply all_blocks_nth; intros k b Hb.
  destruct (nth_error_view_wrap_from _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hb) as (Mi' & HMi'b & ->); cbn [Nat.add].
  destruct (ind_block_members_member _ _ _ HMi'b) as [HMi' _].
  unfold view_wrap_block.
  destruct (List.nth_error vm k) as [v |] eqn:Hv;
    [| apply List.nth_error_None in Hv; pose proof (view_wrap_ok_length _ _ _ Hvw) as Hlv;
       assert (Hk : List.nth_error (ind_members D') k <> None) by (unfold ind_member in HMi'; congruence);
       apply List.nth_error_Some in Hk; unfold ind_member in *; lia ].
  rewrite (List.nth_error_nth _ _ _ Hv).
  destruct (view_wrap_ok_members _ _ _ Hvw _ _ _ HMi' Hv) as (Mv & HMv & Hnn & Hcs & Hcorr).
  destruct (List.nth_error Bks v) as [[nm Z A Bs] |] eqn:Hbv;
    [| cbn beta iota; cbn [eb_binder_count eb_scrutinee_type eb_motive eb_brs]; split;
       [ replace (S (im_nn Mi') - 1 + m) with (im_nn Mi' + m) by lia;
         apply ind_mty_scoped; [ exact HD' | rewrite length_map; exact Hlc | | apply vars_from_scoped; lia ];
         apply List.Forall_map; eapply List.Forall_impl; [| exact HUc ]; intros U HU;
         eapply exp_scoped_wk; [ exact HU |]; intros; unfold wk_shiftn; lia
       | split; [ cbn; lia | exact I ] ] ].
  rewrite HMv; cbn [eb_binder_count eb_scrutinee_type eb_motive eb_brs].
  destruct (blocks_scoped_nth _ _ _ _ HBks Hbv) as (_ & HA & HBs); cbn in HA, HBs.
  split; [| split; [ exact HA |] ].
  {
The container's member type, under its non-uniform parameters.
    pose proof (Hnm _ _ _ HMv Hbv) as Enm; cbn in Enm; subst nm.
    apply ind_mty_scoped; [ exact HD' | rewrite length_map; exact Hlc | |].
    - apply List.Forall_map; eapply List.Forall_impl; [| exact HUc ]; intros U HU.
      eapply exp_scoped_wk; [ exact HU |]; intros; unfold wk_shiftn; lia.
    - apply vars_from_scoped; lia. }
  apply all_brs_Forall, List.Forall_forall; intros [[c n] B] Hin.
  apply List.in_map_iff in Hin as ([c' gs'] & Ecg & Hin'); cbn [fst snd] in Ecg.
  pose proof (f_equal (fun t => snd (fst t)) Ecg) as En'; pose proof (f_equal snd Ecg) as EB; cbn in En', EB.
  rewrite <- En', <- EB.
  assert (Hc' : c' = c) by (pose proof (f_equal (fun t => fst (fst t)) Ecg) as E; cbn in E; exact E); subst c'.
  eapply wrap_branch_scoped; [ exact HD | exact Hl | exact HUs | exact Hnm | exact HBks | exact (decl_closed_members _ HD _ _ HMv) | | | | exact HBs ].
  - intros gs Hgs; exact (Hcorr _ _ _ Hin' Hgs).
  - assert (Hc : In c (List.map fst (im_cons Mv))) by (rewrite Hcs; apply List.in_map_iff; exists (c, gs'); auto).
    apply List.in_map_iff in Hc as ([c0 gs0] & E0 & Hin0); cbn in E0; subst c0.
    exact (cons_lookup_of_in _ _ _ Hin0).
  - intros; eapply Hn; [ exact HMv | exact Hbv | eassumption | eassumption ].
Qed.

A telescope whose entries are each scoped by the ones below it and n.
Lemma ctx_scoped_intro : forall Δ n,
    (forall Δ1 κ T Δ2, Δ = Δ1 ++ ce_ass κ T :: Δ2 -> exp_scoped (List.length Δ2 + n) T) ->
    all_assumptions Δ -> ctx_scoped n Δ.
Proof.
  induction Δ as [| e Δ IH]; intros n H Hass; cbn; [ exact I |].
  inversion Hass as [| ? ? (κ & A & ->) Hass']; subst.
  split; [ exact (H nil κ A Δ eq_refl) |].
  apply IH; [| exact Hass' ]; intros Δ1 κ' T Δ2 ->; exact (H (ce_ass κ A :: Δ1) κ' T Δ2 eq_refl).
Qed.

Lemma member_closed_intro : forall D M,
    all_assumptions (ind_uparams D) ->
    (forall j Mj, ind_member D j = Some Mj -> all_assumptions (im_nparams Mj)) ->
    all_assumptions (im_nparams M) ->
    (forall Δ1 κ T Δ2, im_nparams M = Δ1 ++ ce_ass κ T :: Δ2 -> exp_scoped (List.length (Δ2 ++ ind_uparams D)) T) ->
    (forall qc k' Is vm, im_head M = mh_view qc k' Is vm -> List.Forall (exp_scoped (List.length (ind_uparams D))) Is) ->
    (forall qr Is fl, im_head M = mh_record qr Is fl -> List.Forall (exp_scoped (List.length (ind_uparams D))) Is) ->
    (forall qr Is fl, im_head M = mh_record qr Is fl -> im_nparams M = nil) ->
    (forall qr Is fl c gs, im_head M = mh_record qr Is fl -> In (c, gs) (im_cons M) -> List.length fl = List.length gs) ->
    (forall c gs gs1 ra A gs2, In (c, gs) (im_cons M) -> gs = gs1 ++ ca_arg ra A :: gs2 ->
       exp_scoped (List.length (cargs_nonrec_ctx gs1 ++ im_params D M)) A) ->
    (forall c gs gs1 t gs2 Bs1 B Bs2, In (c, gs) (im_cons M) -> gs = gs1 ++ ca_rec t :: gs2 ->
       ptyp_doms t = Bs1 ++ B :: Bs2 ->
       exp_scoped (List.length (doms_ctx Bs1 ++ cargs_nonrec_ctx gs1 ++ im_params D M)) B) ->
    (forall c gs, In (c, gs) (im_cons M) -> cargs_params_length D gs) ->
    (forall c gs gs1 t gs2 Mj k P T, In (c, gs) (im_cons M) -> gs = gs1 ++ ca_rec t :: gs2 ->
       ind_member D (ptyp_mem t) = Some Mj ->
       nth_error (ptyp_ps t) k = Some P ->
       nth_error (tele_insts (im_nparams Mj)
                    (sb_of_wk (wk_shiftn (ptyp_depth t + List.length (cargs_nonrec_ctx gs1) + im_nn M))) (ptyp_ps t)) k
         = Some T ->
       exp_scoped (List.length (ptyp_tele t ++ cargs_nonrec_ctx gs1 ++ im_params D M)) P) ->
    member_closed D M.
Proof.
  intros D M HassU HassM Hass HN Hh Hrh Hrn Hrl HA HB Hl HPs; constructor; try assumption.
  - apply ctx_scoped_intro; [| exact Hass ]; intros * E; specialize (HN _ _ _ _ E); rewrite length_app in HN; exact HN.
  - intros * Hin Heq; specialize (HA _ _ _ _ _ _ Hin Heq); rewrite length_app, length_im_params in HA; exact HA.
  - intros * Hin Heq; apply ptyp_scoped_intro.
    + intros Bs1 B Bs2 E; specialize (HB _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hin Heq E).
      unfold doms_ctx in HB; rewrite !length_app, length_rev, length_map, length_im_params in HB.
      eapply exp_scoped_mono; [| exact HB ]; lia.
    + destruct (Hl _ _ Hin _ _ _ Heq) as (Mj & HMj & HlMj).
      eapply (nth_typed_scoped _ (tele_insts (im_nparams Mj)
                (sb_of_wk (wk_shiftn (ptyp_depth t + List.length (cargs_nonrec_ctx gs1) + im_nn M))) (ptyp_ps t))).
      * rewrite length_tele_insts; [ unfold im_nn in HlMj; lia | exact (HassM _ _ HMj) ].
      * intros k P T Hk HT; specialize (HPs _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hin Heq HMj Hk HT).
        unfold ptyp_tele, doms_ctx, ptyp_depth in *; rewrite !length_app, length_rev, length_map, length_im_params in HPs.
        eapply exp_scoped_mono; [| exact HPs ]; lia.
Qed.

Lemma decl_closed_intro : forall D,
    all_assumptions (ind_uparams D) -> ctx_scoped 0 (ind_uparams D) ->
    exp_scoped (List.length (ind_uparams D)) (ind_sort D) ->
    (forall k M, ind_member D k = Some M -> member_closed D M) ->
    decl_closed D.
Proof. intros D Hass HΔ HS HM; constructor; assumption. Qed.

A module applied to arguments is as scoped as the module and the arguments.
Lemma me_apps_scoped_iff : forall Ns H n,
    modexp_scoped n (me_apps H Ns) <-> modexp_scoped n H /\ List.Forall (exp_scoped n) Ns.
Proof.
  induction Ns as [| N Ns IH]; intros; cbn; [ split; [ auto | intros []; assumption ] |].
  rewrite IH; cbn; split; [ intros [[] ?]; auto | intros [? HN]; inversion HN; subst; auto ].
Qed.

Lemma ctx_scoped_app_iff : forall Ψ Γ, ctx_scoped 0 (Ψ ++ Γ) <-> ctx_scoped (length Γ) Ψ /\ ctx_scoped 0 Γ.
Proof. intros; rewrite ctx_scoped_app, Nat.add_0_r; reflexivity. Qed.

Closed Entries

What resolution hands back is closed: a definition's type and body, a body module's full telescope, and an alias.
A closed entry: see the section header; an inductive member's group is decl_closed.
Definition entry_closed (E : gentry) : Prop :=
  match E with
  | ge_def _ _ _ A B => exp_scoped 0 A /\ opt_scoped 0 B
  | ge_mod _ _ => True
  | ge_ind _ _ _ D _ => decl_closed D
  | ge_def_mod _ A M U => exp_scoped 0 A /\ exp_scoped 0 M /\ gunit_scoped 0 U
  | ge_record _ _ _ _ => True
  end.

The declaration a module of a member of a group records is closed.
Definition decl_closed_of_ref (oD : option indref) : Prop :=
  match oD with
  | Some (_, _, D) => decl_closed D
  | None => True
  end.

Definition modres_closed (r : modres) : Prop :=
  match r with
  | mr_body T oD => ctx_scoped 0 T /\ decl_closed_of_ref oD
  | mr_alias U => gunit_scoped 0 U
  end.

A body stored closed over a telescope of length k: every definition is closed, every closed submodule is closed over the telescope and its own parameters, every other submodule is closed, and so is every inductive type and inductive alias; a closed body has no local open. Local modules are open: the scoping of local syntax (moddef_scoped) admits no closed body.
Fixpoint body_closed (k : nat) (Φ : gmod) {struct Φ} : Prop :=
  match Φ with
  | gm_nil => True
  | gm_ext Φ' _ E =>
      body_closed k Φ' /\
      match E with
      | ge_def _ _ _ A B => exp_scoped 0 A /\ opt_scoped 0 B
      | ge_mod _ (gu_mk Δ (md_body sm Φ1)) => sm = sm_closed /\ ctx_scoped k Δ /\ body_closed (List.length Δ + k) Φ1
      | ge_mod _ U => gunit_scoped 0 U
      | ge_ind _ _ _ D Φ1 => decl_closed D /\ body_closed (List.length (ind_uparams D)) Φ1
      | ge_def_mod _ A M U => exp_scoped 0 A /\ exp_scoped 0 M /\ gunit_scoped 0 U
      | ge_record _ p R Φ1 =>
          (ctx_scoped 0 (record_fctx R (List.length (record_fields R)) ++ record_params R) /\
           exp_scoped (List.length (record_params R)) (record_sort R)) /\
          body_closed (List.length (record_mod_tele p R)) Φ1
      end
  | gm_open _ _ _ _ => False
  end.

Every definition and every module a module resolves to is closed, the module's own telescope being T.
Definition mod_closed (T : ctx) (Φ : gmod) : Prop :=
  (forall ip E, gm_resolve Φ ip = Some E -> entry_closed E) /\
  (forall x ip r, gm_submodule T Φ x ip = Some r -> modres_closed r).

Definition unit_closed (T : ctx) (Φ : gmod) : Prop := ctx_scoped 0 T /\ body_closed (List.length T) Φ.

Definition units_closed (Θ : gdeps) : Prop :=
  forall fp U, gds_lookup Θ fp = Some U -> unit_closed (gu_params U) (gu_mod U).

A frame's kind is closed: the declaration of the member a type's open frame is the module of, or of the record type it is the module of.
Definition kind_closed (K : frame_kind) : Prop :=
  match K with
  | fk_module => True
  | fk_ind _ _ D => decl_closed D
  | fk_record R =>
      ctx_scoped 0 (record_fctx R (List.length (record_fields R)) ++ record_params R) /\
      exp_scoped (List.length (record_params R)) (record_sort R)
  end.

Fixpoint stack_closed (Ξ : gstack) : Prop :=
  match Ξ with
  | nil => True
  | (_, K, U) :: Ξ' => stack_closed Ξ' /\ unit_closed (gu_params U ++ gs_tele Ξ') (gu_mod U) /\ kind_closed K
  end.

Definition gctx_closed (Θ : gdeps) (Ξ : gstack) : Prop :=
  units_closed Θ /\ stack_closed Ξ.

What a closed body resolves to is closed.
Lemma unit_closed_mod : forall Φ T, unit_closed T Φ -> mod_closed T Φ.
Proof.
  fix IH 1; intros [| Φ y E | Φ H its] T [HT HΦ]; cbn in HΦ; [ split; intros; discriminate | | contradiction ].
  destruct HΦ as [HΦ HE]; destruct (IH Φ T (conj HT HΦ)) as [IHr IHm]; split.
  - intros [| x ip] E0 Hr; cbn in Hr; [ discriminate |].
    destruct (String.eqb x y); [| eapply IHr; exact Hr ].
    destruct ip as [| z ip], E as [b pv A B | pm [Δ [sm Φ1 | E1]] | pv pq k0 D Φ1 | pv Aa Ma Ua | pv pr Rr Φ1]; try discriminate.
    + injection Hr as <-; exact HE.
    + destruct HE as (-> & HΔ & HΦ1).
      assert (Hu : unit_closed (Δ ++ T) Φ1) by (split; [ apply ctx_scoped_app_iff; auto | rewrite length_app; exact HΦ1 ]).
      exact (proj1 (IH _ _ Hu) _ _ Hr).
    + destruct HE as [HD HΦ1].
      assert (Hu : unit_closed (ind_uparams D) Φ1) by (split; [ apply (decl_closed_uparams _ HD) | exact HΦ1 ]).
      exact (proj1 (IH _ _ Hu) _ _ Hr).
    + destruct HE as [[HF _] HΦ1].
      assert (Hu : unit_closed (record_mod_tele pr Rr) Φ1)
        by (split; [ exact (record_mod_tele_scoped _ _ (proj2 (proj1 (ctx_scoped_app_iff _ _) HF))) | exact HΦ1 ]).
      exact (proj1 (IH _ _ Hu) _ _ Hr).
  - intros x ip r Hr; cbn in Hr.
    destruct (String.eqb x y); [| eapply IHm; exact Hr ].
    destruct E as [b pv A B | pm [Δ [sm Φ1 | E1]] | pv pq k0 D Φ1 | pv Aa Ma [Δa [sma Φa | Ea]] | pv pr Rr Φ1]; try discriminate.
    + destruct HE as (-> & HΔ & HΦ1).
      assert (Hu : unit_closed (Δ ++ T) Φ1) by (split; [ apply ctx_scoped_app_iff; auto | rewrite length_app; exact HΦ1 ]).
      destruct ip as [| z ip]; [ injection Hr as <-; split; [ apply Hu | exact I ] |].
      exact (proj2 (IH _ _ Hu) _ _ _ Hr).
    + destruct ip; [ injection Hr as <-; exact HE | discriminate ].
    + destruct HE as [HD HΦ1].
      assert (Hu : unit_closed (ind_uparams D) Φ1) by (split; [ apply (decl_closed_uparams _ HD) | exact HΦ1 ]).
      destruct ip as [| z ip]; [ injection Hr as <-; split; [ apply Hu | exact HD ] |].
      exact (proj2 (IH _ _ Hu) _ _ _ Hr).
    + destruct ip; [ injection Hr as <-; exact (proj2 (proj2 HE)) | discriminate ].
    + destruct HE as [[HF _] HΦ1].
      assert (Hu : unit_closed (record_mod_tele pr Rr) Φ1)
        by (split; [ exact (record_mod_tele_scoped _ _ (proj2 (proj1 (ctx_scoped_app_iff _ _) HF))) | exact HΦ1 ]).
      destruct ip as [| z ip]; [ injection Hr as <-; split; [ apply Hu | exact I ] |].
      exact (proj2 (IH _ _ Hu) _ _ _ Hr).
Qed.

Lemma stack_closed_in : forall Ξ mp K U,
    stack_closed Ξ -> List.In (mp, K, U) Ξ -> exists T, unit_closed T (gu_mod U).
Proof.
  induction Ξ as [| [[mq Kq] V] Ξ IH]; intros * HΞ Hin; cbn in *; [ contradiction |].
  destruct HΞ as [HΞ [HV _]]; destruct Hin as [[= <- <- <-] | Hin]; eauto.
Qed.

The declaration a type's open frame carries is closed.
Lemma stack_closed_ind : forall Ξ p pq k D, stack_closed Ξ -> gs_find_ind Ξ p = Some (pq, k, D) -> decl_closed D.
Proof.
  induction Ξ as [| [[mq Kq] V] Ξ IH]; intros * HΞ Hf; cbn in *; [ discriminate |].
  destruct HΞ as [HΞ [_ HK]].
  destruct (qname_strip mq p) as [[| ? ?] |]; [| discriminate | eauto ].
  destruct Kq; [ discriminate | injection Hf as -> -> ->; exact HK | discriminate ].
Qed.

The declaration a record's open frame carries is closed.
Lemma stack_closed_record : forall Ξ p R, stack_closed Ξ -> gs_find_record Ξ p = Some R ->
    ctx_scoped 0 (record_fctx R (List.length (record_fields R)) ++ record_params R) /\
    exp_scoped (List.length (record_params R)) (record_sort R).
Proof.
  induction Ξ as [| [[mq Kq] V] Ξ IH]; intros * HΞ Hf; cbn in *; [ discriminate |].
  destruct HΞ as [HΞ [_ HK]].
  destruct (qname_strip mq p) as [[| ? ?] |]; [| discriminate | eauto ].
  destruct Kq; [ discriminate | discriminate | injection Hf as ->; exact HK ].
Qed.

Lemma stack_closed_find : forall Ξ p U ip T,
    stack_closed Ξ -> gs_find_tele Ξ p = Some (U, ip, T) -> unit_closed (gu_params U ++ T) (gu_mod U).
Proof.
  induction Ξ as [| [[mq Kq] V] Ξ IH]; intros * HΞ Hf; cbn in *; [ discriminate |].
  destruct HΞ as [HΞ [HV _]].
  destruct (qname_strip mq p); [ injection Hf as <- <- <-; exact HV | eauto ].
Qed.

Lemma gctx_closed_resolve : forall Θ Ξ p b pv r A B,
    gctx_closed Θ Ξ ->
    gc_resolve Θ Ξ p = Some (ge_def b pv r A B) ->
    exp_scoped 0 A /\ opt_scoped 0 B.
Proof.
  intros * [HΘ HΞ] Hr.
  destruct (gc_resolve_inv _ _ _ _ Hr) as [(mp & K & U & ip & Hin & Hm) | (fp & U & Hl & Hm)].
  - destruct (stack_closed_in _ _ _ _ HΞ Hin) as (T & HU).
    exact (proj1 (unit_closed_mod _ _ HU) _ _ Hm).
  - exact (proj1 (unit_closed_mod _ _ (HΘ _ _ Hl)) _ _ Hm).
Qed.

Every entry of a closed body is closed.
Lemma body_closed_entry : forall Φ k ip E, body_closed k Φ -> gm_entry Φ ip = Some E -> entry_closed E.
Proof.
  fix IH 1; intros [| Φ y E0 | Φ H its] k ip E HΦ He; cbn in HΦ, He; [ discriminate | | contradiction ].
  destruct HΦ as [HΦ HE]; destruct ip as [| x ip]; [ discriminate |].
  destruct (String.eqb x y); [| exact (IH _ _ _ _ HΦ He) ].
  destruct ip as [| z ip].
  - injection He as <-.
    destruct E0 as [b pv A B | pm [Δ [sm Φ1 | E1]] | pv pq k0 D Φ1 | pv Aa Ma Ua | pv pr Rr Φ1]; cbn;
      first [ exact HE | exact I | exact (proj1 HE) ].
  - destruct E0 as [b pv A B | pm [Δ [sm Φ1 | E1]] | pv pq k0 D Φ1 | pv Aa Ma Ua | pv pr Rr Φ1]; try discriminate.
    + exact (IH _ _ _ _ (proj2 (proj2 HE)) He).
    + exact (IH _ _ _ _ (proj2 HE) He).
    + exact (IH _ _ _ _ (proj2 HE) He).
Qed.

Every entry of a closed global context is closed.
Lemma gctx_closed_entry : forall Θ Ξ p E,
    gctx_closed Θ Ξ -> gc_entry Θ Ξ p = Some E -> entry_closed E.
Proof.
  intros * [HΘ HΞ] He; unfold gc_entry, gc_entry_u in He.
  destruct (gs_find Ξ p) as [[U ip] |] eqn:Hf.
  - destruct (gs_find_unit _ _ _ _ Hf) as (mp & K & Hin & _).
    destruct (stack_closed_in _ _ _ _ HΞ Hin) as (T & _ & HU).
    exact (body_closed_entry _ _ _ _ HU He).
  - destruct (gds_lookup Θ (q_unit p)) as [U |] eqn:Hl; [| discriminate ].
    exact (body_closed_entry _ _ _ _ (proj2 (HΘ _ _ Hl)) He).
Qed.

Lemma gctx_closed_module : forall Θ Ξ p r,
    gctx_closed Θ Ξ ->
    gc_module Θ Ξ p = Some r ->
    modres_closed r.
Proof.
  intros * [HΘ HΞ] Hr; unfold gc_module, gc_module_u in Hr.
  destruct (gs_find_tele Ξ p) as [[[U [| x ip]] T] |] eqn:Hf; [ discriminate | |].
  - exact (proj2 (unit_closed_mod _ _ (stack_closed_find _ _ _ _ _ HΞ Hf)) _ _ _ Hr).
  - destruct (gds_lookup Θ (q_unit p)) as [U |] eqn:Hl; [| discriminate ].
    pose proof (HΘ _ _ Hl) as HU0; destruct HU0 as [HT _]; destruct (unit_closed_mod _ _ (HΘ _ _ Hl)) as [_ HU].
    destruct (q_chain p) as [| x ip]; cbn in Hr; [ injection Hr as <-; split; [ exact HT | exact I ] | exact (HU _ _ _ Hr) ].
Qed.

Lemma gctx_closed_mind : forall Θ Ξ p pq k D,
    gctx_closed Θ Ξ -> ind_mlookup Θ Ξ p = Some (pq, k, D) -> decl_closed D.
Proof.
  intros * HΘ Hl; destruct (ind_mlookup_module _ _ _ _ Hl) as [[T Hm] | Hf].
  - exact (proj2 (gctx_closed_module _ _ _ _ HΘ Hm)).
  - exact (stack_closed_ind _ _ _ _ _ (proj2 HΘ) Hf).
Qed.

Lemma gctx_closed_ind : forall Θ Ξ p D,
    gctx_closed Θ Ξ -> ind_lookup Θ Ξ p = Some D -> decl_closed D.
Proof.
  intros * HΘ Hl; destruct (ind_lookup_mlookup _ _ _ _ Hl) as [pq Hm]; exact (gctx_closed_mind _ _ _ _ _ _ HΘ Hm).
Qed.

Lemma mod_closed_nil : forall T, ctx_scoped 0 T -> unit_closed T ⋄.
Proof. intros; split; [ assumption | exact I ]. Qed.

What an entry adds is closed if the entry is.
Definition entry_ok (T : ctx) (E : gentry) : Prop :=
  match E with
  | ge_def _ _ _ _ _ => entry_closed E
  | ge_mod _ (gu_mk Δ (md_body sm Φ)) => sm = sm_closed /\ unit_closed (Δ ++ T) Φ
  | ge_mod _ U => gunit_scoped 0 U
  | ge_ind _ _ _ D Φ => decl_closed D /\ unit_closed (ind_uparams D) Φ
  | ge_def_mod _ _ _ _ => entry_closed E
  | ge_record _ p R Φ =>
      (ctx_scoped 0 (record_fctx R (List.length (record_fields R)) ++ record_params R) /\
       exp_scoped (List.length (record_params R)) (record_sort R)) /\
      unit_closed (record_mod_tele p R) Φ
  end.

Lemma mod_closed_ext : forall T Φ x E, unit_closed T Φ -> entry_ok T E -> unit_closed T (Φ ⊳ x ↦ E).
Proof.
  intros * [HT HΦ] HE; split; [ exact HT |]; cbn; split; [ exact HΦ |].
  destruct E as [b pv A B | pm [Δ [sm Φ1 | E1]] | pv pq k0 D Φ1 | pv Aa Ma Ua | pv pr Rr Φ1]; cbn in HE |- *; try exact HE.
  - destruct HE as (-> & HΔ & HΦ1); apply ctx_scoped_app_iff in HΔ as [HΔ _].
    rewrite length_app in HΦ1; auto.
  - destruct HE as [HD [_ HΦ1]]; auto.
  - destruct HE as [HR [_ HΦ1]]; auto.
Qed.

A chain from a unit has no variable.
Lemma mod_qname_scoped : forall H p n, mod_qname H = Some p -> modexp_scoped n H.
Proof.
  induction H; intros * Hp; cbn in *; try discriminate; auto.
  destruct (mod_qname H) eqn:E; [ eauto | discriminate ].
Qed.
